protocol.model_identity_limit: Mutable alias; official page declaration, not verified fixed weights. Both arms regenerated contemporaneously.
protocol.price_basis: Official peak cache-miss input/output rates, USD per million tokens; cache/off-peak savings not assumed in reserve.
protocol.comparison: Identical direct Q8/Q9 messages; only requested temperature differs.
protocol.primary_comparison: temperature_10 minus baseline; temperature_08 is secondary sensitivity
protocol.candidate_gate: Exploratory only: primary paired Q9 W1 upper95<0, Q9 center point no worse, model validity>=99%; no automatic default upgrade.
limits: Four inspected development months, not independent validation.
Four generations are repeats of identical virtual people, not extra sampled households.
Survey weights are archived sensitivity weights, not a fresh national sample.
Temperature can add random variation without useful personal heterogeneity.
Noise decomposition is equal-person descriptive and does not identify human psychology.

auxiliary_survey_weighted.weight_definition: Parent SCE survey weight × parent-stratum size / selected-stratum size; descriptive sensitivity only.

paired_intervals.scope: Exploratory unadjusted paired person clusters, months/repeats kept together; not time-generalization intervals.

temperature_10_minus_baseline.scope: Exploratory unadjusted paired person clusters, months/repeats kept together; not time-generalization intervals.

temperature_08_minus_temperature_10.scope: Exploratory unadjusted paired person clusters, months/repeats kept together; not time-generalization intervals.

notes: No correction of invalid replies. Human scores are reused from frozen evaluation; new model vectors use the same scorer.
All-arm/both-repeat common support; macro and individual metrics are distinct; repeats are not extra people.
Reused baseline cost is historical, excluded from this batch estimated_actual_cost_usd.

temperature_dispersion.identity: pooled population variance = variance of person repeat means + average within-person population variance
temperature_dispersion.noise_adjustment: sample variance of person repeat means minus mean within-person sample variance / R; negative estimates retained
temperature_dispersion.limits: Four repeats estimate API variability, not real human repeat variability. Stable between differences are not automatically correct personal predictions.
